events.title: CNA Financial Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates on Weak Underwriting Income
events.body: CNA's Q1 earnings miss estimates as higher claims and a weaker combined ratio pressure underwriting, offsetting modest premium and investment income gains.

events.title: NMI Holdings Q1 Earnings, Revenues Top, Insurance in Force Rises Y/Y
events.body: NMIH tops Q1 estimates as revenues rise 5.8% and primary insurance in force climbs to $222.3B, even as persistency slips and claims surge.

events.title: Hanover Insurance Q1 Earnings Top Estimates on Lower Cat Losses
events.body: The Hanover Insurance Group's Q1 operating EPS rose 36% to $5.25, beating estimates as pricing and loss trends drove a record 20.3% ROE.

events.title: ALL Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Underwriting, Lower Expenses
events.body: Allstate's Q1 earnings surge 202% as strong underwriting, higher premiums and lower catastrophe losses drive a major profit beat.
